description: Runs hybrid semantic + keyword search (backed by Cloudflare AI Search) across all published pages on telehealthnearme.pro: in-depth English and Spanish (/es/) guides, rankings, GLP-1 Price Index, Billing Cycle Audit, Fine Print & Transparency Index, methodology, LegitScript explainer, and program profiles. Returns top scored Markdown excerpts with source URLs (no generated answer). Use when a user asks conceptual, editorial, or how-to questions (e.g. "how to check if online peptide therapy is legit", "enclomiphene vs testosterone TRT", "como empezar GLP-1 sin seguro", "28-day vs 30-day telehealth billing cycles"). For structured program filtering, exact annual cost math, or state-aware /go/ links, use search, find_programs, calculate_true_cost, or check_fine_print.

limit.description: Optional, default 5. Maximum number of content chunks to return (1–10).

query.description: Required. Natural-language question or keywords in English or Spanish.
examples: how to check if online telehealth is legit
cuanto cuesta semaglutida sin seguro en espanol

name: search_site_content
title: Semantic search across guides, rankings, and site content
